name: Nanbu Tsukasa
source:
Younger of the protagonist's two blood-related sisters. She is cool and open, and unreservedly erotic.

When they were kids, she played doctor with the protagonist, using it as a pretext to play naughty pranks on him...

[Adapted from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/character444.html]official website[/url]]
